decisions.reason: As an adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display it still builds directly on our core design and production knowledge, so despite weaker visibility we are more likely to refine or sell it project-specifically than withdraw it now.

This standard quarter-pallet cardboard display overlaps heavily with nearby variants and, after limited visible traction, our existing knowledge lets us conclude that resources are better shifted to stronger core formats and new developments.
The eighth-pallet format remains a distinct and familiar extension of our established display business, which we can continue to adapt efficiently with current capabilities and customer insight.

The wooden display pallet is less aligned with our paper-based competence base, and with muted evidence of market pull we have less scope to improve it through our accumulated knowledge than our core cardboard offerings.
